reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation follows the Latin closely throughout: tenses (futures in 16-17, jussive fiant in 18, perfects in 6-12) are preserved, the Septuagintal deprecabitur in 14 is rendered as the Latin reads it (se deixara aplacar) rather than by the Hebrew, and the ambiguity of quoniam suave in 3 is kept. Only permitted liberties appear (copulas in 13 and 15, participle and relative clauses in 7a/7b turned into finite verbs, natural word order); pointing marks match the Latin in every verse."}
